title: Goldman in talks with investors on Nvidia financing deal after landing prized role, sources say
title_zh: 消息人士称，高盛在获得宝贵职位后正在与投资者就英伟达融资交易进行谈判
summary: Goldman Sachs is in talks with potential investors about participating in Nvidia's $500 billion AI financing initiative, after leveraging its long-standing relationship with the chipmaker to secure a coveted role in the deal, people familiar with ‌the matter said. U.S.
summary_zh: 知情人士称，高盛正在与潜在投资者就参与英伟达 5000 亿美元的人工智能融资计划进行谈判，此前高盛利用其与芯片制造商的长期合作关系，在该交易中获得了令人垂涎的角色。我们。

title: How Investors May Respond To Walmart (WMT) Earnings Countdown And New Exclusive Family-Focused Offerings
title_zh: 投资者如何应对沃尔玛（WMT）盈利倒计时和新的以家庭为中心的独家产品
summary: In recent weeks, a stream of partner announcements has brought new exclusive products and wellness offerings to Walmart stores and Walmart.com, while the retailer also prepares to report its second-quarter earnings on August 20, 2026.
summary_zh: 最近几周，一系列合作伙伴公告为沃尔玛商店和 Walmart.com 带来了新的独家产品和健康产品，同时该零售商还准备于 2026 年 8 月 20 日报告第二季度收益。

title: MP Materials Just Signed a Secret Aerospace Deal. Here's Why It Matters.
title_zh: MP Materials 刚刚签署了一项秘密航空航天协议。这就是为什么它很重要。
summary: MP Materials is expanding its product portfolio and customer list.
summary_zh: MP Materials 正在扩大其产品组合和客户名单。

title: Quantinuum’s Cloud Deal With Oracle Sends Clear Message on Hybrid AI
title_zh: Quantinuum 与 Oracle 的云交易就混合人工智能发出了明确的信息
summary: Quantinuum is putting its Helios quantum computer inside Oracle Cloud, pairing quantum power with AI as revenue and bookings surge in Q2.
summary_zh: 随着第二季度收入和预订量的激增，Quantinuum 正在将其 Helios 量子计算机放入 Oracle 云中，将量子能力与人工智能结合起来。

title: What Is Oracle (ORCL) Building With Its New AI And Quantum Deals?
title_zh: 甲骨文（ORCL）通过其新的人工智能和量子交易正在构建什么？
summary: Oracle (NYSE: ORCL) extended its long term collaboration with Amazon Web Services to help enterprises run Oracle AI Database workloads on AWS.
summary_zh: Oracle（纽约证券交易所股票代码：ORCL）扩大了与 Amazon Web Services 的长期合作，帮助企业在 AWS 上运行 Oracle AI 数据库工作负载。
